items.title: Composable Banking, Canonical Payments: A Foundation for Agentic Operations
items.summary: Financial institutions face a critical challenge: legacy payment architectures are fragmented, rigid, and deeply siloed, making it difficult to adapt to new payment rails or build trustworthy systems for AI operations. To overcome these limitations, banks need an operational data foundation that decouples payment logic from tightly coupled legacy systems.
